personalInfo.name: Recep ŞEN
personalInfo.about: I design the architecture behind Easyapp.ai at Taptoweb and work on distributed systems and AI agents.

projects.title: Easyapp
projects.description: An AI-powered no-code platform for creating and monetizing mobile mini apps, accessible via link, no download required. Users describe their business and AI generates a production-ready app in under a minute, complete with push notifications, loyalty programs, in-app payments, appointment booking, and 20+ more built-in services. Features its own app store across 16 categories. Led the architecture and development of the microservices infrastructure serving 250,000+ users.

projects.title: aciktir.io
projects.description: An AI-powered SaaS platform for restaurant management and QR-based ordering. Businesses manage orders, receipts, and analytics through a kanban board, with catalog management covering products, categories, coupons, option groups, cross-selling, and package menus. Supports multi-branch management, team access control, table grouping, and multiple order types (dine-in, takeaway, delivery). Customers order via QR web menu, AI chatbot, or WhatsApp AI bot.

projects.title: QMS - Quality Management System
projects.description: An enterprise-grade quality management system built on ISO 9001 standards. Covers document management with two-stage approval workflows, revision history, controlled distribution, and read confirmations, alongside a corrective action (CAR/DFI) module with an 8-step workflow, root cause analysis, cost tracking, and PDF reports. Includes real-time SSE notifications via Redis, async email delivery through BullMQ, and role-based access control.

projects.title: Portfolio Template
projects.description: A fast, SEO-optimized portfolio template with unlimited language support, dark/light themes, and fully customizable sections for any profession. Built with Next.js 15 and React 19. MIT licensed.

projects.title: CSharpEssentials
projects.description: Simplifies C# development by providing essential building blocks, including a framework for implementing common design patterns such as the Result Pattern, Any Pattern, and Maybe Pattern.

projects.title: tsentials
projects.description: Simplifies TypeScript error handling with railway-oriented programming. Provides Result<T>, Maybe<T>, Rule Engine, DDD patterns, and 20+ composable modules for type-safe functional programming with zero dependencies.

projects.title: Aspire Microservice Starter Template
projects.description: A production-ready starter template for .NET microservices built with the Aspire Framework. Provides service defaults, health checks, distributed tracing, and container orchestration out of the box, a structured foundation for building observable, cloud-native services.

projects.title: Pixfete
projects.description: A self-hosted event photo sharing platform. Guests scan a QR code to upload photos and videos from their phones, which appear in a shared gallery after admin moderation. Features in-browser video re-encoding, multi-storage backend (Cloudflare R2, Google Drive, local disk), event countdown, location map, and WhatsApp fallback for uploads.

projects.title: Invitra
projects.description: A real-time wedding and event guest management system. Track guests by name, potential and confirmed headcount, priority group, transport type, and organizer. The live dashboard synchronizes capacity statistics, group breakdowns, and transport data across multiple organizers simultaneously via WebSockets.

projects.title: Career & Salary Comparison Simulator
projects.description: Turkey's most comprehensive salary comparison tool for calculating and comparing net income between SGK employees (4/a) and Bağ-Kur self-employed (4/b). Covers gross/net salary, taxes, premiums, and employer costs with 2026 TES Reform simulation, Young Entrepreneur and Service Export exemptions, and TRY/USD currency support.

blogPosts.title: Your Function Signature Is Lying: Managing Errors as Values in TypeScript
blogPosts.description: Discover why try/catch falls short in TypeScript, the advantages of managing errors as values with Railway Oriented Programming, and pragmatic functional programming with tsentials' Result<T>, Maybe<T>, RuleEngine and more.

blogPosts.title: Stop Writing Code, Start Managing Systems: The Real Potential of AI-Powered Development
blogPosts.description: Stop treating AI as an autocomplete and start thinking like a CTO. A comprehensive guide to Claude Code covering CLAUDE.md strategy, context management, hooks, custom agents, multi-agent orchestration, model routing, and self-learning systems.

blogPosts.title: AI Coding Tools: The Complete Guide to Claude Code, OpenCode & Modern Development
blogPosts.description: From zero to production: Master AI-assisted development with the right tools. Learn Claude Code, OpenCode, oh-my-opencode, MCP, skills, and advanced techniques for professional development.

blogPosts.title: Production-Grade AI Development with Claude Code: A Comprehensive Ecosystem Guide
blogPosts.description: Transform Claude Code from a simple Q&A tool into a professional-grade development environment with plugins, custom agents, skills, MCP servers, and hooks.

blogPosts.title: Performance Analysis of Parameter Passing Methods in C#
blogPosts.description: Deep dive into C# parameter passing: Comparing struct, class, record & ref types with benchmarks. Learn best practices for optimization.

blogPosts.title: The Modern Way to Manage C# Business Rules: Rule Engine Pattern
blogPosts.description: A modern C# pattern for managing business rules that provides centralized control, high testability, and optimal performance through the Result Pattern

blogPosts.title: Google Cloud Secret Manager Integration for Your .NET Applications
blogPosts.description: A .NET library for Google Cloud Secret Manager integration with features like prefix filtering, region-specific configuration, and JSON/raw secret support

blogPosts.title: Blockchain Based E-Voting System
blogPosts.description: This research proposes the development of a secure and fast online voting system using blockchain technology. This system not only offers low processing delay and high security level but also simplifies the verification of data integrity across multiple polling stations.
